owner_persona_workflow_simulation.moment: 23h45 - owner ferme le rideau, ouvre laptop, /admin/cash-overview
owner_questions_observed: Q1: 'Combien on a fait aujourd'hui vs hier ?' -> wants J vs J-1 ratio
Q2: 'Combien vs meme jour semaine passee ?' -> wants J vs S-1 ratio (mardi vs mardi)
Q3: 'Qu'est-ce qui a le mieux marche ce soir ?' -> wants top items du jour (chart or list)
Q4: 'Combien je commande de pain demain ?' -> wants prediction/forecast based on historical pattern
Q5: 'Cassoulet brule, file d'attente 30 min, panne TPE 19h-20h' -> wants daily incident log
Q6: 'Le comptable veut le X du jour en PDF lundi matin' -> wants 1-click PDF export
Q7: 'Le comptable veut la liste detaillee en Excel' -> wants 1-click XLSX export
Q8: 'C'etait gros ce soir, surnormal ou ouvert?' -> wants anomaly auto-detect (revenue > mean + N*sigma)
Q9: 'Mon caissier a-t-il cloture trop tard, ecart bizarre ?' -> wants cross-session anomaly (variance pattern across days)

gap_1_compare_J_vs_J_minus_1_vs_S_minus_.owner_verbatim: Compare J vs J-1, J vs S-1 ?

evidence_chain.claim: CashOverviewController returns ONLY the requested window (default today). NO previous-period delta in summary payload.
evidence_chain.interpretation: summary payload contains NO j_minus_1, week_ago, delta_pct, trend fields. Owner must run TWO sequential requests (today, yesterday) and compute the delta mentally.

evidence_chain.claim: Frontend renders summary cards (grand_total + by_source) and mode breakdown chips - NO delta cell, NO arrow up/down, NO % change indicator
evidence_chain.verbatim:
{{ $t('label.grand_total') }}
{{ formatMoney(summary.total) }}

evidence_chain.claim: Codebase-wide grep for J-1 / previousDay / week_over_week / previous_period / comparedTo returned ZERO hits in admin/cash domain. Only KDS/OSS services reference 'yesterday' for advance-order overdue logic - unrelated.

Sibling /admin/dashboard SalesSummaryComponent renders absolute totals; OverviewComponent renders absolute totals; RealtimeReportComponent renders 24h sliding window. NONE expose J vs J-1 or J vs S-1.

gap_1_compare_J_vs_J_minus_1_vs_S_minus_.consequence: Owner cannot answer 'is today better or worse than yesterday / same-day-last-week' without manual arithmetic on two separate page loads. Night-shift signal-detection is impossible.
gap_1_compare_J_vs_J_minus_1_vs_S_minus_.fix_estimate: M (4-6h) - backend SHOULD compute summary_previous_day + summary_previous_week in same response (3 SUMs over (today, J-1, S-1) windows, scoped to branch_filter), frontend adds 2 delta cells per source card + a % indicator (green up / red down). Single endpoint call, single render.

evidence_chain.claim: CashOverviewController returns Transaction rows (payment-level), NEVER OrderItem rows. Top-items-by-revenue / top-items-by-qty is NOT computable from the current payload.
evidence_chain.interpretation: Order is eager-loaded WITHOUT orderItems / items. No item-level aggregation possible from this endpoint.

evidence_chain.claim: MostPopularItemsComponent EXISTS on /admin/dashboard but is all-time, not day-scoped
evidence_chain.interpretation: no date filter passed - it is a static list, not 'top items aujourd'hui'.

evidence_chain.claim: No charting library imported in /admin/cash-overview component scope. CashOverviewComponent.vue has zero <canvas>, zero ApexCharts, zero Chart.js, zero d3 imports.
Codebase-wide grep for chart.js / apexcharts / d3 in resources/js/components/admin/cashOverview returned ZERO hits.

gap_2_top_items_du_jour_chart.consequence: Owner cannot see 'le Cayenne XXL a fait 18 ventes ce soir, le Salade Cesar zero' without leaving cash-overview and querying sales-report manually (Excel download, then human Pivot). Night-shift menu-engineering decision is blind.
gap_2_top_items_du_jour_chart.fix_estimate: M (5-8h) - new endpoint GET /api/admin/cash-overview/top-items?from=&to=&limit=10 returning [{item_id, name, qty, revenue}] sorted by revenue or qty. Frontend renders simple horizontal-bar visualization (CSS-only or lightweight chart). Reuses Order::orderItems relation, scoped to branch_filter.

evidence_chain.claim: Codebase-wide grep for predict / forecast / prediction / prevision returned ZERO hits in app/ or resources/js/.
No predictive model, no rolling-average widget, no day-of-week pattern surface anywhere in admin.
evidence_chain.evidence: RealtimeReportComponent shows present-tense 24h-sliding only. LastZReportWidget shows only the most recent Z. No 'previsions demain mardi' widget.

gap_3_predict_tomorrow_based_on_history.consequence: Owner cannot pre-order suppliers based on data signal. Decision is 'a la louche' or based on memory of last Tuesday.
gap_3_predict_tomorrow_based_on_history.fix_estimate: L (15-25h) - requires (a) day-of-week clustering over 4-8 weeks history, (b) seasonality adjustment if data exists, (c) per-item or per-category prediction. Likely DEFER to V1.0.2 / V1.0.3 backlog. Cheap MVP: simple 'meme jour semaine derniere = X EUR / Y commandes' header banner on dashboard - covers 80% of the persona need at cost S (2-3h).

evidence_chain.claim: CashDrawerSession schema has variance_reason VARCHAR but it is per-cashier-close, NOT day-level owner incident log
evidence_chain.interpretation: variance_reason is bound to a single drawer close, used by cashier to justify a +/- ecart. Owner cannot use it for 'panne TPE 19h-20h, cassoulet brule, file d'attente' day-narrative.

evidence_chain.claim: No incidents table, no daily_notes table, no shift_notes table found in migrations.
No incident-related UI control in CashOverviewComponent.vue (no <textarea>, no save-note button, no incidents list, no date-scoped note section).
ActionLog model exists for system-event audit but is for code-generated events (orders, transitions, security), NOT for free-form owner shift narrative.
evidence_chain.model: app/Models/ActionLog.php (verified exempted from BranchScope sentinel V1.0.2 backlog)

gap_4_note_incident_journalier.consequence: Owner has nowhere in the app to write 'panne TPE entre 19h-20h, paiement carte HS, on a fait que cash'. This context is essential when comptable + insurance reviews the ecart 3 weeks later.
gap_4_note_incident_journalier.fix_estimate: S-M (4-6h) - new migration + cash_overview_incidents (id, branch_id, business_date DATE, occurred_at_local TIME nullable, severity ENUM info/warning/critical, title VARCHAR(120), body TEXT, author_user_id), Admin/CashOverviewController action + form section in CashOverviewComponent.vue. Reuses cash-sessions-report permission. Branch-scoped. NF525 read-only sibling, no fiscal-chain impact.

evidence_chain.claim: CashOverviewController returns ONLY JsonResponse from a single GET action; no exportPdf / exportExcel methods exist
CashOverviewComponent.vue contains NO 'Export PDF', NO 'Export Excel', NO downloadCsv button. Only filter form + Search + Clear.

Libraries ARE installed in composer.json (barryvdh/laravel-dompdf, maatwebsite/excel) and HEAVILY used in 9 other admin controllers (ChefController, DeliveryBoyController, SalesReportController, TableOrderController, ItemController, DiningTableController, CreditBalanceReportController, ItemCategoryController, TransactionController) - so the wiring is trivial; cash-overview is just NOT wired.
evidence_chain.evidence_grep_Excel_facade: 9 hits in app/Http/Controllers/Admin/* - none in CashOverviewController.php

evidence_chain.claim: Sibling /admin/cash-sessions-report (Wave O4) also lacks PDF/Excel export per CashSessionReportListComponent.vue check

gap_5_export_pdf_excel_comptable.consequence: Owner ne peut PAS donner un fichier au comptable. Owner doit screenshot la table HTML + envoyer en pdf manuel, OU passer par /admin/transactions ou /admin/sales-report (qui sont des SOURCES DIFFERENTES et n'ont PAS la dimension source caisse/borne/livreur que cash-overview ajoute). C'est le gap LE PLUS COUT/VALUE du persona owner-night.
gap_5_export_pdf_excel_comptable.fix_estimate: S (2-4h) - app/Exports/CashOverviewExport.php (FromCollection or FromQuery) reusing the same Transaction::with(...) builder + 1 line in controller: 'if ($request->wantsXlsx()) return Excel::download(new CashOverviewExport($filters), "cash-overview-YYYYMMDD.xlsx")'. PDF idem with PDF::loadView('admin.exports.cash-overview', $data)->download(...). Frontend adds 2 buttons calling /api/admin/cash-overview?export=xlsx. ZERO new dependencies.

evidence_chain.claim: Per-session variance threshold EXISTS in CashDrawerService for individual drawer close
evidence_chain.interpretation: Only flags a SINGLE cashier close where |variance| > 2.00 EUR. Used for audit logging, not surfaced to owner-night dashboard.

evidence_chain.claim: NO daily-revenue anomaly detection (today vs mean(last_N_days)). NO sigma/outlier detection. NO cross-session pattern alerts.
CashOverviewComponent.vue surfaces total + by_source + by_mode but NO 'anormalement eleve' indicator, NO red badge, NO comparison band.

gap_6_anomaly_auto_detect_caisse_above_a.consequence: Owner cannot trust 'ca m'a paru gros ce soir' - either it's a real bumper night to celebrate, or it's a data anomaly (double-count, duplicate POST, terminal repaiement, livreur 2x cash). The variance_threshold protects the cashier-close moment, NOT the day-summary moment.
gap_6_anomaly_auto_detect_caisse_above_a.fix_estimate: M (6-10h) - extend backend with rolling-mean over last 28 days (same day-of-week), tag today's row with deviation_sigma + status (normal / high / very_high). Frontend renders a coloured strip on the grand_total card. Cheaper variant (S, 2-3h): static config('cash.daily_total_alert_eur', 500) banner if today > X EUR. Defer full sigma model to V1.0.2.

f1_cash_diff_cell_dropped_v1_no_count_in.context: Wave X-C round-2 2026-05-21 fix C-013 dropped the diff cell entirely because it was algebraically locked to -opening_amount. The honest reconciliation requires a 'counted_physical_cash' input from cashier - which is V1.0.2 backlog per the in-file comment line 116-119.
f1_cash_diff_cell_dropped_v1_no_count_in.relevance_to_owner_night: Owner cannot verify the ecart caisse without a manual count input. Today the dashboard says 'expected = 1234 EUR' but nowhere does it ask 'how much did you count in the drawer ?'

f2_cap_at_500_rows_silent.context: Hard cap 500 rows per call (MAX_ROWS const line 70). Above that, meta.capped=true and a yellow banner shows but the owner has no easy pagination - must narrow date range manually.
f2_cap_at_500_rows_silent.relevance_to_owner_night: Two-week reviews silently miss tail rows. For PDF/Excel export this matters (auditor sees a truncated table).

f3_no_dashboard_widget_for_cash_overview.context: CashOverviewComponent is only accessible via /admin/cash-overview deep-link or the quick-access tile in DashboardComponent (push line 143). It is NOT injected as a widget into the main /admin dashboard - so the owner-night persona must remember to navigate there. No cashflow-of-the-day card on /admin/dashboard.

f4_other_bucket_filter_silently_dropped.context: The 'other' payment_method bucket is non-filterable (paymentMethodPatternsForBucket returns empty array). This was an explicit Wave Z Q7 removal of the dropdown option, but the bucket still exists in summary.by_mode. So an owner who sees a 5 EUR 'autre' line in summary cannot drill down to which transaction it was.
f4_other_bucket_filter_silently_dropped.relevance_to_owner_night: Forensic drill-down blocked on the rarest bucket - the exact bucket most likely to be a config drift.

top_3_priorities.rationale: Highest value-per-effort: 2-4h work, removes a HARD-blocking owner-night chore (sending file to comptable), reuses libs already in vendor. Owner mandate 'meme endroit en base' + comptable PDF/Excel is the canonical accountant deliverable. Quick-win, ZERO architectural risk, ZERO frozen-zone touch.

Comptable + insurance + owner-memory all depend on context that LIVES NOWHERE today. variance_reason on cash-drawer-close is per-cashier not per-day-owner. 1 new table + 1 form panel = 4-6h. High asymmetric value because absence of this data CANNOT be recovered later.

Night-shift signal-detection is the core owner job. Without J vs J-1 the dashboard is a flat number with no judgement context. 4-6h to compute 3 windows in the same controller call + 2 delta cells in the Vue template. Same data domain, ZERO new query patterns.
top_3_priorities.owner_impact: Night-shift judgement, trend awareness, anomaly priming

verdict.summary: The /admin/cash-overview page is RECONCILIATION-CORRECT (Wave X-C round 2 caught the diff-cell algebra bug, drawer cash_collected unfiltered fix is shipped, branch-isolation/NF525 invariants hold). But it is OWNER-NIGHT-INCOMPLETE: 5/6 owner workflows verbatim listed in the prompt are MISSING or PARTIAL. The page is a CASHIER reconciliation tool that an OWNER uses by hand-rolling deltas, comptable-files, incident-context, and prediction. Highest-leverage P1 fixes are estimated 2-6h each, all NF525-safe, all frozen-zone-safe. P0 fiscal correctness = SOLID. P1 owner-night UX = WEAK. Recommend bundling fixes #5 + #4 + #1 as Wave 'X5 Owner-Night Heal' (~14h total) before declaring cash-overview production-perfect for the owner persona.
verdict.production_ship_status: GO for cashier reconciliation; CONDITIONAL for owner-night persona (5 owner mandate gaps verified ABSENT, of which 3 are P1)
